audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows handed the stage to Cassiopeia while the same rows' why-text says the opposite — whys[1] calls it 'a skill window', whys[2] 'stays even', whys[3] 'you out-trade', whys[6] 'you still own the early-to-mid wall game'. The header also called it an 8.5/10 hard matchup against a 51.74% win rate and a diff of EVEN.
audit.why: The packet chart is Poppy/Skill/Skill/Poppy/Cassiopeia/Skill/Poppy, which is exactly what the why-text argues and exactly the chart the mirror audit says is correct. Side and rating are enum fields, so the mirror's belief that single-word flips fail the length band was wrong — they apply.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 6 flipped in both layers as one group with ratings raised to match, and the difficulty brought back to 6/10 to agree with EVEN.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns despite the whole page being organised around 'the Miasma cooldown'.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and only 16s maxed — that is a huge early window and a small late one. Twin Fang is 0.75s and Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: 24s, 0.75s and 120s written into dosFull[0], dontsFull[1] and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two false interactions: the page twice said to 'hold your own R to cancel hers' or to break the face-stun, and it credited Miasma (W) with being her poke damage. Petrifying Gaze is an instant cast, not something Keeper's Verdict interrupts, and you cannot cast while stunned. Miasma slows, grounds and lightly damages; Twin Fang (E) is the damage and the heal.
audit.why: Riot's text: R stuns enemies in front of her who are facing her and slows those with their back turned — the counterplay is turning away, not ulting. W's own text is 'lightly damaging'. E deals increased damage to poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage dealt. The grounding claim on Miasma stopping Poppy's E dash is genuine and kept.
audit.corrected: Turn-away counterplay replaces the ult-cancel myth; Twin Fang named as the damage and heal source; the grounding kept with its real 24s cooldown.

audit.why: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt on a 0.75s cooldown — that is the sustain that beats a Poppy grind.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to dontsFull[1], the cooldown block and the late-game text.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Miasma and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by dodging Miasma's grounding and by whether a wall is behind her.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and it grounds you — your E dash dies inside it, so engage once it fades.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Twin Fang heals her every 0.75s — anti-heal before any long trade.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Miasma: 24s at rank 1, 16s maxed — grounded means your E dash never fires, so wait the cloud out. - Twin Fang: 0.75s, and it heals her, so buy Grievous Wounds. - Petrifying Gaze: 120s — it only stuns you if you are facing her.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia's Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. When it is down — E wall-stun + Q burst.
edits.after: Miasma grounds you for 24s at rank 1 — no E dash inside it. Petrifying Gaze stuns only if you face her; turn away and it is a slow.

edits.before: Her R face-stun roots you facing her and stacks Twin Fang poison while you can't combo — this 6 window is hers unless you hold R to break it.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns you only if you face her, and Twin Fang pours in while you're locked — the 6 window is hers unless you turn away.

edits.before: Bait her R and look away or hold your own R to break the face-stun before her poison stacks
edits.after: Turn your back before Petrifying Gaze lands — facing away downgrades the stun to a slow

edits.before: Land Q (Noxious Blast) for the move speed then chunk you with W poison from max range
edits.after: Land Noxious Blast (Q) for the move speed, then melt you with Twin Fang every 0.75s

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours on the all-in: she's squishy, has no dash to escape your E, and your W's armor/MR steroid soaks her poison while you close. At 6 the lane flips for one window — her R face-stun roots you so her Twin Fang ticks pour in, and you can't combo while stunned. Look away to deny the stun, or hold your own R to cancel hers, then resume the wall-slam game.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours on the all-in: she's squishy, has no dash to escape your E, and your W's armor/MR steroid soaks her poison while you close. At 6 the lane flips for one window — Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her, so it locks you while Twin Fang pours in every 0.75s. Turn your back as she casts and it becomes a slow, then resume the wall-slam game.

edits.before: First item is comfortable — cheap tank/bruiser parts let you survive a full Q-W rotation and your kit value is gold-independent, so keep forcing wall-stuns and side-lane picks. But by 2+ items a full-AP Cassiopeia out-scales you hard: she kites on bootless passive move speed, grounds your E, and her sustained poison out-DPSes your flat base damage. Close this before her items come online and let your team body her in fights where your W and R peel.
edits.after: First item is comfortable — cheap tank/bruiser parts let you survive a full Q-W rotation and your kit value is gold-independent, so keep forcing wall-stuns and side-lane picks. By 2+ items a full-AP Cassiopeia kites on her passive move speed, grounds your E with a 16s Miasma, and heals off every Twin Fang — Grievous Wounds is mandatory. Close it early and let your team body her in fights where your W and R peel.

notes: Two myths removed: Keeper's Verdict does not cancel or break Petrifying Gaze (it is an instant cast, and you cannot cast while stunned) — the real counterplay is facing away, which downgrades it to a slow; and Miasma is not her poke damage, Twin Fang is. Following the mirror, I made no untargetability claim about Keeper's Verdict — Riot's text says only that she channels. The chart was five rows out of line with its own why-text and with the packet; flipped as one group in both layers, and the 8.5/10 difficulty brought down to 6/10 to match the EVEN verdict and the 51.74% win rate.
